ncei_comparison.comparison: SPC regular daily CSV Sep-key rows sum 64; NCEI published value is 57*. Difference: SPC row total is 7 greater. Not reconciled; no claim of formula, event, or count equivalence.

coverage_limits: SPC names each daily file by YYMMDD; current SPC archive page directly verified a 261018 file covers 2026-10-18 12Z to 2026-10-19 11:59Z. These date keys are 12Z report windows, not midnight-to-midnight U.S. local monthly bins. Sep30 key window crosses into Oct1 UTC; Aug31 key included for the Sep1 boundary. CSV Time alone does not fully map events to NCEI month assignment.

Daily regular Tornado Reports CSV rows are SPC report entries, not unique surveyed tracks. Per SPC FAQ recorded in mapping packet, regular feed deduplicates reports sharing occurrence time/location under its rules; no further event-level or cross-day dedupe was attempted. Exact repeated full rows within the 31 individual CSVs: 0.

NCEI report says 57 SPC preliminary tornado reports and separately reports confirmed counts by EF rating totaling 45; that report and SPC daily rows differ by 7. Scope/vintage/mapping that explains difference remains unverified. The crosscheck establishes mismatch only, not a conversion. NCEI report is Oct14 publication; bodies retrieved Oct20 at recorded times above.
